title: 법무자문위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Staff)
(1) The Committee shall have a total of not more than 12 specialist members or research members. <Amended on August 31, 1985; and February 3, 2022.>
(2) Specialist members and research members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Justice from among persons with specialized knowledge and experience in law, and their term of office shall be two years. <Amended on August 31, 1985; and February 3, 2022.>
(3) Under the orders of the Minister of Justice or the Chairperson, specialist members and research members shall perform the following duties: <Amended on February 3, 2022.>
1. Collection of materials, investigations and research concerning matters deliberated upon by the Committee or subcommittees;
2. Legal review and support relating to improvement and operation of statutes and regulations concerning legal affairs;
3. Investigation and research of legal theories and judicial precedents in Korea and abroad.
(4) The Committee shall have one secretary to handle its affairs. <Amended on February 3, 2022.>
(5) The secretary shall be designated by the Minister of Justice from among public officials affiliated with the Ministry of Justice. <Newly Inserted on February 3, 2022.>
(6) The Minister of Justice may have public officials under the Minister's jurisdiction support the duties of the Committee through specialized planning and research concerning matters deliberated upon by the Committee. <Newly Inserted on August 6, 2007; amended on February 3, 2022.>
